ads.source: Meta Ad Library, active ads, 29 Oct 2026
points: Your site shows 2580 reviews, yet 0 of 30 ads carry a proof number, so new buyers have no reason to trust the brand. Put the review count on the creative and open two ads with a customer quote.
Your site leads with 50% off, yet only 4 of 24 ads mention percent off, so most of your ads never show the discount. Open three new ads with 50% off in the first line and print it on the creative.
One exact copy runs in 8 of 24 ads, so the same buyers see the same message again. Keep the copy, but give each of those 8 ads a new opening line and a new creative, so each ad feels new.

8 of 24 copy ads open on “if you’ve been thinking about”, and the rest are single use. Test two new angles against that opener: a customer quote about the daily ritual, and the two-minute routine with no machine.
